purpose: Derive a narrow, content-addressed structural identity for the exact SYN-PY-01 canonical guard-operand projections so a later C1 repair can distinguish the canonical projection from same-depth but different projections without using identifier spelling as semantic meaning.

motivation.remaining_gap: Projection shape agreement does not distinguish two different one-hop fields or literal-key projections.

derivation_contract.guard_selection: Use only an exact frozen canonical guard anchor/span supplied by the SYN-PY-01 canonical seed record or an exact content-addressed canonical anchor record bound to its anchor_contract_sha256. If no unique exact frozen guard span is available, fail closed before producing authority.
derivation_contract.source_role_root: Map each selected role only through the frozen SYN-PY-01 execution-profile parameter_index within the exact guard scope.
derivation_contract.terminal_slot: Map each selected role only to the frozen canonical consequence signature required_binding_slot_roles operand_index.
derivation_contract.local_aliases: Straight-line local aliases before the guard may be traversed, but local variable spelling is not included in the fingerprint.
derivation_contract.attribute_step_identity: ATTRIBUTE token identity = SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 attribute token, emitted only as a digest and never interpreted as semantic meaning.
derivation_contract.subscript_step_identity: SUBSCRIPT_LITERAL token identity = SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes for the exact literal key, emitted only as a digest and never interpreted as semantic meaning.
derivation_contract.shape_crosscheck: Map each admitted projection step to DERIVES and require the resulting edge-kind sequence to equal the single frozen lineage_edge_shapes sequence for that source role. Any missing, multiple, unsupported, or mismatching shape fails closed.
derivation_contract.root_and_terminal_crosscheck: Require exactly one root role and exact required guard operand index for each derived path.
derivation_contract.fingerprint: For each role, hash canonical JSON of {root_role,terminal_guard_operand_index,steps:[{kind,token_digest_sha256}]}; raw token spelling is not emitted.

output_contract.semantic_scope: Structural projection identity relative to the frozen canonical SYN-PY-01 source only; does not independently assign domain meaning.

independence_contract.primary_builder: stdlib Python AST only; candidate/C1/primary repaired semantic packages may not be imported.
independence_contract.independent_checker: A separately implemented checker must rederive the same two opaque fingerprints from the same canonical inputs without importing the builder.
negative_tests: same root + same depth + different attribute token must mismatch
same root + extra projection must mismatch
wrong root + same projection must mismatch
wrong required operand index must mismatch
subscript literal token mismatch must mismatch
ambiguous alias origin must fail closed
unsupported dynamic subscript must fail closed
canonical profile shape mismatch must fail closed

forbidden_inputs: Any Candidate58 candidate or mutant bytes
Gate2C3 per-case source bytes or per-case projection tokens

claim_boundary.allowed: State the exact opaque structural projection identity frozen by the canonical SYN-PY-01 baseline and whether two independent derivations agree.
forbidden: claiming identifier spelling carries semantic meaning
claiming a future candidate matches this identity before independently checking that candidate
claiming C1 repair soundness or VALID_C1 coverage gain
generalizing the projection identity to SYN-PY-02, Go, or TypeScript

execution_contract.canonical_execution: two deterministic derivations plus independent checker agreement
